title: Pay in Chicago versus New Orleans
summary: Chicago paid far better than the New Orleans district, where a night earned a dollar and a half plus tips; room rent was cheap in New Orleans.

story.theme_name: Getting paid: wages, tips and leaving over money
story.community_name: Getting paid: wages, scale and the pay envelope

blocks.x: She said she wanted to play with the jazz band. She said, it's all right, Eddie. I'm glad she's gone. Glad for you to have her. Was pay better in Chicago than in New Orleans? Oh, sure. Was much? Oh, sure. Was there a big difference in what you could earn?
No, a big difference in day and night.
Look, you play down the district. Now, all right. Go down there, you play from 9 o'clock, 4 o'clock in the month, of course, you make tips. You got only a dollar and a half of that.

The next work, down the course, but you can do so much with that dollar and a half, though. You understand, Nick? Sure. Well, you got up to Chicago, you see. You got more money than Chicago. And this is thick now in Chicago. Next time, when the rule is getting, they get 18, 18, 17, 1850 and 25 hours a week. Uh-huh. In Chicago, you see.
It's much different. In New Orleans, you only pay two dollars a week for a room in New Orleans. Couldn't pay no two dollars a week for no room out this way. Yeah.
Is that one of the reasons why I went to Chicago? Because pay was higher? Pay was higher.
